_notes.source: Live https://takeprofittrader.com/ plan cards read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 - monthly prices unchanged ($150 / $170 / $245 / $330 / $360). Also /affiliate and /terms. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: standard = the monthly Test subscription price from the official plan data ($150 / $170 / $245 / $330 / $360 for 25K / 50K / 75K / 100K / 150K). The plan data has no separate discounted price, so promo is null. A promo code NOFEE40 was advertised on the homepage banner on 2026-10-03: 40% off the monthly Test price for the life of that test, plus the $130 PRO activation fee waived. The help centre gives only one worked example ($50K test for $102 with NOFEE40); per-size promo prices are not shown, so they are not calculated or listed. Earlier codes (NOFEE30, NOFEE50, 50AND3) were time-limited and have ended.
_notes.billing: The Test is a monthly subscription that rebills on the same calendar day each month until the trader passes or cancels; it does not cancel automatically after a rule break. On passing, the subscription stops and a one-time $130 PRO activation fee is charged (waived on accounts bought with some promo codes). No monthly fees in PRO. Test resets cost $79 / $99 / $139 / $169 / $199 (25K-150K) and do not change the renewal date. Simulated commissions of $4.50 (mini) / $1.50 (micro) per round trip apply in Test and PRO.
_notes.daily_loss: The plan cards show the Daily Loss Limit as 'Removed' and the homepage comparison table lists the daily loss rule as 'None' for Test, PRO and PRO+, so daily_loss = "none". (PRO+ Development accounts, which TPT may assign at its discretion, have a soft-breach daily loss limit that pauses trading.)
_notes.drawdown: Test: end-of-day trailing drawdown (updates at 5 PM ET) that stops trailing at the starting balance. PRO: intraday trailing drawdown of the same amount. PRO+: end-of-day drawdown.
_notes.consistency: 50% consistency rule in the Test only (best day must be below 50% of total net profit; the target rises automatically if not met). No consistency rule in PRO or PRO+.
_notes.min_trading_days: 3 trading days for tests bought from 17 August 2026 (older tests keep 5).
_notes.profit_split: PRO (simulated) 80/20, withdrawable once the account is above a buffer equal to the max drawdown (e.g. $52,000 on a 50K). PRO+ (live account) 90/10 with no buffer, but PRO+ is by invitation at TPT's discretion. profit_split_max = 90.
_notes.payout_caps: Official pages say there is no maximum withdrawal amount and no scaling plan; so payout_cap is 'none' (shown as None). Wallet withdrawals of $250 or less carry a $50 fee. Payouts via Plaid (US banks), PayPal or Wise.
_notes.fee_refund: Terms (2026-10-20): change-of-mind refund within 72 hours of purchase, minus a $75 fee. No refund of the Test fee with payouts, so fee_refund = false.
_notes.platforms: 15+ platforms on two data feeds. CQG: TradingView, NinjaTrader, Tradovate. Rithmic: R|Trader, Quantower, Bookmap, MultiCharts, MotiveWave, Trade Navigator, VolFix, ATAS, Investor R/T, Finamark, Jigsaw Trader. Only the main ones are listed in the platforms array.
_notes.other_rules: No automated/bot trading in PRO. No counter positions across accounts (all account types). PRO and PRO+ must be flat around FOMC, NFP and CPI releases (Test may trade news). PRO max 50 executions per day. Up to 5 PRO/PRO+ accounts at once; unlimited tests. PRO and PRO+ must trade at least one day per week.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Take Profit Trader page (or not expressible as one number - see the notes above). Check the live plan page before publishing.
_notes.company_check: https://takeprofittrader.com/about-us and site footer (checked 2026-10-11): TakeProfitTrader LLC, 9100 Conroy Windermere Rd Suite 200, Windermere, FL 34786. No founding date stated, so founded is null. Google Maps search (2026-10-20) found no Take Profit Trader listing.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://takeprofittrader.com/affiliate (2026-10-20): 'now accepting new partners'; commission 10% to 25% based on referred clients' lifetime spend; free to join; affiliate dashboard and customisable affiliate homepage. Cookie length, payout method, minimum, country and comparison-site rules not stated. Apply: 'Sign me up now!' on that page.

firm.name: Take Profit Trader
firm.name_note: Take Profit Trader (takeprofittrader.com), operated by TakeProfitTrader LLC. Often shortened to TPT.
firm.about: Take Profit Trader is a futures-only firm that sells a one-step, monthly-subscription Test in five sizes from $25K to $150K. Traders who pass move to a simulated PRO account where withdrawals are available from the first day, and may later be invited to a live PRO+ account.

countries.notes: Residents of the listed countries cannot use the platform, and trading or even viewing market data from a listed country (including through a VPN or remote connection) can get accounts blocked. The list includes territories such as Christmas Island, Cocos (Keeling) Islands, Cook Islands, Falkland Islands, Heard and McDonald Islands, Mayotte, Montserrat, Northern Mariana Islands, Palestinian Territories, South Georgia, Svalbard and Jan Mayen, and Western Sahara. Several EU countries are on it (Bulgaria, Croatia, Malta, Romania, Slovenia). Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). VPNs are not allowed during registration. The UAE and the US are not on the list. TPT says the list can change with regulatory or brokerage updates.
